title: Channel Synthesizer
text: 多相 FFT 合成滤波器组，输入 2 路、输出 1 路；{InterpolationFactor} 指定插值因子 Number of frequency、{Polyphase filter specification} 指定滤波器设计参数或系数 Number of taps per band and stopband、{Number of filter taps per frequency band} 指定每个频带的滤波器系数数量、{Stopband attenuation (dB)} 指定阻带衰减、{Specify coefficients from input port} 用于指定低通滤波器系数的标志、{Prototype lowpass filter coefficients} 指定原型低通滤波器的系数 rcosdesign、{Simulate using} 指定要运行的仿真类型 Interpreted，按实例取值。

ports.name: x
ports.summary: 输入窄带信号 Q -by- M matrix | L -by- M -by- N array

ports.name: coeffs
ports.summary: 原型低通滤波器系数 row vector

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: 宽带信号 Q×M -by-1 vector | L×M -by- N matrix

params.name: InterpolationFactor
params.values: 插值因子 Number of frequency bands (default) | positive integer

params.name: Polyphase filter specification
params.values: 滤波器设计参数或系数 Number of taps per band and stopband attenuation (default) | Coefficients

params.name: Number of filter taps per frequency band
params.values: 每个频带的滤波器系数数量 12 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Stopband attenuation (dB)
params.values: 阻带衰减 80 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Specify coefficients from input port
params.values: 用于指定低通滤波器系数的标志 off (default) | on

params.name: Prototype lowpass filter coefficients
params.values: 原型低通滤波器的系数 rcosdesign(0.25,6,8,’sqrt’) (default) | row vector

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: 要运行的仿真类型 Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
